original.description: The first troop departure from the Gare de l’Est, Paris, 2 August 1914. Catalogued by the Bibliothèque nationale de France as "2-8-14, mobilisation, le premier départ, gare de l’Est : [photographie de presse]", subject headings "Guerre mondiale (1914-1918); Trains; Paris (France) -- Gare de l’Est; France. Armée -- Mobilisation".
original.photographer: Agence Rol (press agency; the operator is not named)
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Agence Rol collection, reference Rol 41629; digitised on Gallica (btv1b69310801), via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; the record’s permission note is publication before 1 January 1931). Credit line on the record: Bibliothèque nationale de France.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize — the French infantry’s madder-red trousers and dark blue greatcoat of 1914 are documented, and this is where the pack can show them without a posed manoeuvre photograph.

content_policy: ok — a departure platform, no gore
caption: The first departure from the Gare de l’Est, Paris, 2 August 1914. Everything after this ran to a timetable written years in advance.
credit: Original photograph: Agence Rol, Paris, 2 August 1914; Bibliothèque nationale de France, Rol 41629, via Gallica and Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Pairs with the Alsace-Lorraine goods wagon already in the registry: the same day, the French side of it.
